item1.title: A personal touch.
item1.copy: Every property belongs to someone. We start by listening to what you have in mind and the way you want to enjoy your outdoor space.

item2.title: Pride in the details.
item2.copy: A neat edge. A thoughtfully placed plant. A freshly cared-for bed. We believe the little things help bring the whole yard together.

item3.title: Experience, put to work.
item3.copy: More than {{experienceYears}} years of hands-on landscaping experience guide the care we bring to the homes and businesses around our community.

seo.title: About Our Family-Owned Team | Flores Landscaping, {{city}}
seo.description: Get to know Flores Landscaping, a family-owned and operated business with over {{experienceYears}} years of experience serving {{city}} and nearby communities. Licensed and insured. Free estimates.

companyIntro.heading: Local roots.
companyIntro.paragraph: Behind every well-cared-for yard are people who take pride in it. We’re Flores Landscaping—a family-owned team helping outdoor spaces around {{city}} feel a little more like home.

photo.alt: A person working near newly mulched beds beside a porch

ourStory.text: Good people. Thoughtful work. A little pride in every detail.
ourStory.heading: People who care.
ourStory.paragraph: Good landscaping starts with a personal connection.
ourStory.paragraph2: Flores Landscaping is a family-owned and operated business with more than {{experienceYears}} years of experience serving {{city}} and the surrounding communities. Caring for local outdoor spaces is what we do, from everyday lawn care to landscape design and seasonal cleanups.
ourStory.paragraph3: We know a yard is more than the space around a building. It’s the welcome at your front door, the view from your window, and a place to spend time outside. We bring that same personal attention to the properties we care for.

companyValues.heading: Care is personal.
companyValues.paragraph: From the first conversation to the finishing touches, these are the things that matter to us.

companyCommunity.heading: Rooted here.
companyCommunity.paragraph: We serve residential and commercial properties in {{city}} and nearby communities. Wherever you are in our service area, we’d love to hear what you have in mind for your space.
companyCommunity.paragraph2: Nearby, but don’t see your community?
companyCommunity.linkLabel2: Give us a call to check your area.

estimate.heading: Let’s get to know
estimate.paragraph: Tell us a little about your property and the care you’re looking for. We’ll start with a conversation and a free estimate.
estimate.text2: CALL OR TEXT THE FLORES TEAM
estimate.linkLabel2: Prefer email? We’d love to hear from you.
